title: Behead
summary: BEHEAD', verb transitive behed'. [be and head.] To cut off the head; to sever the head from the body, with a cutting instrument; appropriately used of the execution of men for crimes.

inlines.v: BEHEAD', verb transitive behed'. [be and head.] To cut off the head; to sever the head from the body, with a cutting instrument; appropriately used of the execution of men for crimes.
